subject: Edge relay performance validation + commercial path for Datadog co-sell
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Matt Taylor <matt.taylor@datadog.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@metricly.consulting>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Edge relay performance validation + scope for pilot

Hi Matt / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, we'd like to run a focused pilot where Metricly runs the edge relay/OTLP proxy in a customer-like topology and we validate:

- ingest throughput (events/sec) at typical batch sizes
- CPU and memory profile during bursts
- end-to-end latency to Datadog intake when using our prefix caching and batching

Proposal: Redwood provides a small test harness and config recommendations, Metricly deploys the relay in their lab and runs the attached load plan. Datadog agrees to capture resulting traces/metrics and share perf counters for root-cause comparisons.

Deliverables:
1) perf-raw-results.csv from load runs (attach)
2) a 2-page SOW for a short co-innovation pilot (we'll draft)
3) a short co-sell play (pricing guardrails + one-pager)

I attached an initial load plan and a stub SOW. Can you confirm timelines for running 3x load passes next week? Also please add whoever owns procurement at Datadog so we can flag lead times for any reserved nodes for bigger runs.

Attachments: [Attachment: edge-relay-load-plan.xlsx], [Attachment: redwood-sow-draft.pdf]

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Alliances Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

From: Matt Taylor <matt.taylor@datadog.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procure@datadog.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge relay performance validation + scope for pilot

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear plan. Datadog is supportive of a short pilot. A couple of clarifying Qs before we lock dates:

1) Can you confirm the target max throughput (events/sec) and typical batch sizes you'll simulate? We need that to size the agent nodes on our side.
2) Do you expect the relay to terminate TLS or passthrough? That changes CPU overhead significantly.
3) If we share internal counters, what PIIs are present in the traces — and will Redwood accept redacted samples?

On timelines: we can allocate bench time Wed-Fri next week if Metricly can run the harness then. Procurement (cc'd) — if we need reserved capacity beyond a one-off bench, what's the expected commit? Ben / Laura — can you confirm commercial packaging expectations so Matt knows if this will convert to a paid pilot or an engineering partnership?

Regards,
Matt
Matt Taylor
Technical Partner Manager — Observability Integrations, Datadog
matt.taylor@datadog.com

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@metricly.consulting>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Matt Taylor <matt.taylor@datadog.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge relay performance validation + scope for pilot

Thanks — A few notes from Metricly's side:

- We can run batches up to 5k events/sec per relay instance for 1 minute bursts; 1k sustained. We'll attach raw logs.
- We'll configure the relay to terminate TLS for the bench (easier instrumenting) but can repeat with passthrough if needed.
- We'll sanitize payloads; no PII will leave our lab.

We're good to run Wed/Thu. Attaching our initial pass as perf-raw-results.csv.

Attachments: [Attachment: perf-raw-results.csv]

Best,
Aisha Khan
Principal Systems Engineer, Metricly Consulting
aisha.k@metricly.consulting

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Matt Taylor <matt.taylor@datadog.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@metricly.consulting>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge relay performance validation + scope for pilot

Thanks team — quick commercial note:

- For a pilot like this we usually do a short engineering engagement (2-4 weeks) under a reduced fixed fee and separate commercial terms if the customer converts. Suggested pilot fee: $25k to cover engineering time + sandbox infra.
- If Datadog wants to include this in a co-sell, we'll need a one-page pricing guardrail and an initial manifest (how many seats/nodes) so legal and procurement can pre-authorize.

Matt — can procurement advise acceptable PO cadence? If procurement needs a contract we can fast-track a short SOW + MSA addendum (attached).

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-sow-draft.pdf]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Matt Taylor <matt.taylor@datadog.com>, procure@datadog.com, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@metricly.consulting>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge relay performance validation + scope for pilot

Matt / Procurement / Aisha —

Next steps and action items from Redwood:

1) Sofia to share final load plan and test harness by EOD Wed (Drive link below).
2) Metricly to run three passes Wed-Thu and upload perf-raw-results.csv to the Drive folder.
3) Datadog to send counter exports and a short list of expected headers we should expect in the agent metrics.
4) Ben to circulate the pilot fee and a one-page co-sell guardrail by COB Thu.
5) Procurement: if reserved infra is needed beyond bench time, please confirm lead times and PO process.

Security request: please send SOC 2 type II report or a pointer to your attestation portal (Datadog and Metricly) ahead of any paid engagement. We will need that for our PS compliance.

Drive (shared): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example
Jira (tracking): SUP-1428
HubSpot record: HS:2439123

Attachments referenced above.

Thanks everyone — aiming to have a decision on conversion path by next Tue.

Laura Bennett
Director, Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
